correctness.rationale: For extraspecial |G|=p^{1+2n}, the commutator on G/Z(G) is a nondegenerate alternating F_p form. The p(p−1) lifts over nonzero vectors in each projective point form a maximal independent false-twin class, and distinct projective points have distinct orthogonal hyperplanes. There are v=(p^{2n}−1)/(p−1) such classes. Twin transpositions force ≥s−1 selected elements/class in either resolving or determining sets. Conversely, with this many selected, an omitted pair in different classes is separated by a landmark in one class if nonorthogonal, or by a landmark over a hyperplane symmetric-difference point if orthogonal. A graph automorphism fixing all selected vertices must fix each twin class, and its at most one omitted vertex, hence determining. The complete enumerator is (sx^{s−1}+x^s)^v, beta=Det=v(s−1), bases=s^v. Independently exhausted all 64 vertex subsets for order-eight extraspecial graph, obtaining 8x³+12x⁴+6x⁵+x⁶.
